label: Upper Halfway Brook confluence, northwestern branch entry
identity_evidence: Northwestern Halfway Brook branch joins the main channel at the western large fork; the western tributary reaches the opposite side a short distance south. Both sources preserve these approaches, the downstream eastward reach and a separate northern tributary farther east. Halfway Brook continues to the Neils Harbour area. Use the northwestern branch/main-stroke junction; exclude the western/southern bank node and nearby HALF lettering. Original river line277178 is named Halfway Brook and terminates at the selected north-bank node. Small modern tributaries and bank detail are not all engraved. The mouth/name location was used only to identify the river; no estuarine classification boundary or name point is used as the GCP.
phase: First fresh northeastern interior check after North Pond-supported TPS11 freeze; no tuning
